reviewFeedbackIntegratedBeforeBaseline: Block4 explicitly identifies Fengjie as unworthy even to pick up Ping’er shoes.
Block7 identifies elder master’s wife rather than grandmother.
checkedAndRetained: Monthly ten plus ten liang; annual four/five hundred and one/two hundred; initial fifty; joking twenty/thirty thousand; four dozen not substituted for forty strokes; several hundred cash.
Lai grandson age thirty, manumission at birth, office qualification purchase at twenty, actual appointment ten years later; three banquet days and fourteenth date.
Baochai medical advice remains character speech: ginseng/cinnamon heat, liver-wood subduing stomach-earth, swallow nest one liang and rock sugar five qian by weight.
Daiyu fifteen, orphan dependence versus Baochai family/resources, reciprocal confidence and teasing retained without invented motives.
All ten verse blocks / twenty lines: repeated autumn, green dream, tearful candle, low candlestick, silk coverlet, water clock, wind/rain and wet gauze-window images.
Rain gear three objects, removable bamboo fastening/top, cotton gauze stockings and rain-shoe handling; walnut-sized gold watch and xu/hai timing.
Glass lamp versus mingwa lamp, two older women ahead and two girls behind, eventual lamp handed to girl with Baoyu holding shoulder.
Sugar one package, night gambling, Daiyu tip, gratitude/envy/propriety anxiety and sleep near end of fourth watch.
